$comment: The expected seed for each test-set row, written by hand (#2075 part 2). Never generated: each value cites the source it was read from, and neither path's output is a source. A null color means the right seed declares none. `pending` rows have no snapshot yet: the read-only procedure in README.md produces them.

reference-brand.kind: repo: the reference brand's legacy Figma variable export (variables, no layers)

primary.source: #CF0A2C, the hero red the reference brand's own brief pins (packages/engine/examples/nb-redesign.design.md `primary`); the file holds it as `color/red/550`

accent.source: the brief declares no accent. The file names an amber `text/accent` role; a reader could defensibly propose it, so a pick here is scored `extra`, not `wrong`, and the findings discuss it

families.source: the file's `font/family/display` and `font/family/body` roles. The redesign brief moved body to another face; the key is what the FILE says

radiusScale.source: `radius/md` = 4px = the engine's base md (scale 1). The redesign brief sets 0; the key is what the FILE says

actionPalette.source: the reference brand's own brief pins `actionPalette: neutral` (packages/engine/examples/nb-redesign.design.md, "actions are black, not red"); the file's `button/foreground/primary/default` and `interactive/text/default` alias `color/neutral/950`

prism2.kind: repo: Prism 2's Figma variable export (variables, no layers, three modes)

primary.source: #1E1EFF, `color/brand/primary/650`, which every `action/primary/*/rest` role and `text/brand/primary` point at (packages/engine/examples/prism3.design.md measures the same value)

accent.source: #6502E6, `color/brand/secondary/650`, which `text/brand/secondary` and `surface/brand/secondary` point at. `action/accent/*/rest` points two rungs darker (`/750`), so any rung of this ramp is a family match

radiusScale.source: `border/radius/button` = 4px; the default ramp reproduces Prism 2's container ramp 2/4/6/8/12/16 (packages/engine/scale.ts RADIUS_LADDER)

actionPalette.source: every `action/primary/*/rest` role points at `color/brand/primary/650`, the primary

emission-prism3.kind: repo: the engine's own Figma emission for the default theme (variables + text styles)

actionPalette.source: packages/engine/examples/prism3.design.md sets no `actionPalette` (action = primary, the default)
